headline: Frontline Battles Multiply Across Six Sectors as Fighting Accelerates
war_summary: While Callum's Cape and Mooring County continue their brutal attritional clash, fresh tactical upheavals have erupted across Stonecradle, Marban Hollow, Weathered Expanse, and Linn of Mercy over the past two hours. In Mooring County, intense fighting around The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast produced six base transitions and over forty-six hundred combined casualties, keeping Colonial resistance pinned to a lone redoubt against ten Warden positions. Callum's Cape suffered more than four thousand dead across the same interval with two fresh shifts, leaving one base neutralized between four Warden and two Colonial holdings. Simultaneously, the struggle spread to sectors previously thought quiet: Stonecradle witnessed six rapid base exchanges at The Dais and World's End, Marban Hollow reawakened with four changes focused on Checkpoint Bua, and Weathered Expanse ignited with three base transitions and nearly two thousand casualties. Linn of Mercy also resumed movement with two shifts and heavy Warden attrition. In contrast, the Nevish Line, Stlican Shelf, and Godcrofts sectors have settled into operational quiet, recording no territorial changes over the latest six hours.
